dispatch: Sequential on the qualified slot until an independently checked concurrent allocation is documented before the next physical start.
screening: Store every stock. Native input present in each sampled action window, at least 99% correct four-tick intervals, true original terminal, current and next stocks, physically received native inputs and correct behavior re-forward. An ambiguous or interrupted original is retained and excluded.
reward: Native Stage1 delta tick divided by 15652, verified crossing +1. Per-credit prospective λL=0 or 1, Φ=λL*(spares+1) on live states and Φ=0 at Game Over, γ=.999.
